tolerance.pattern: ^shellAcceptsOwnFaces / shellRejectsPartiallyForeignFaceList \[own, foreign\] -> \[own\]: upward=1 done=1 valid=1 volume=[-0-9.eE+]+$
tolerance.reason: the same kernel non-determinism as the line below, in the same BRepOffsetAPI_MakeThickSolid family. Thirty runs of one binary against the pinned v4.0.0-kernel.3 asset printed 4519.4099853010057 seventeen times, ...66 twelve times and ...48 once, a relative spread of 4.0e-16. It drifts less often than its neighbour, which is why #2965 reported only one line of this probe: a whole-population run caught it on the third try. `upward=1 done=1 valid=1` and every word of the label stay compared exactly. The cause is #3003. #2965.

tolerance.pattern: ^shellRejectsPartiallyForeignFaceList \[foreign\] -> no open face: done=1 valid=1 volume=[-0-9.eE+]+$
tolerance.reason: the line #2965 measured. Thirty runs of one binary against the pinned asset printed four distinct values, -13587.492558290327 to ...32, a relative spread of 3.7e-16, a couple of units in the last place of a double; the transcript's ...29 is one of them. Declared as a tolerance rather than volatile because the volume IS the measurement: `done=1 valid=1` and every word of the label stay compared exactly, and the run prints the worst difference it saw. The cause is #3003. #2965.
